name: The Hunt: Roblox 20
desc:
Go back through 20 years of Roblox and experience where it all began, one era at a time. Some games will feel instantly familiar. Others may surprise you. And there's always more to the story.

Subscribe to Roblox Plus to get early access to the hub and up to three additional exclusive items during the event. Early access runs from 9 AM to 2 PM PDT.

💠 Discover iconic games throughout Roblox history.
💠 Complete event quests to unlock rare and exclusive rewards.
💠 Interact with creators you know and love.
💠 Experience nostalgia in whole new ways.
💠 Stay tuned for more surprises as The Hunt: Roblox 20 unfolds.
 
It’s all happening right here from September 17-28.
